narrative.intro: American Centrifuge Operating recorded $916M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. American Centrifuge Operating received 2 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $458M. Obligations rose significantly year over year, up 361.8%. Historical obligations show growth from $38.9M in FY21 to $198M in FY25, then to $916M in FY26. Market detail by NAICS shows Other Basic Inorganic Chemical Manufacturing as the dominant market with $900M, followed by Nuclear Electric Power Generation with $15.9M. The current-year totals are partial, fiscal year to date, and the figures listed are contract obligations except for award-value figures in largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Readers should treat the FY2026 totals as not final for the fiscal year. This summary focuses on contract obligations, award counts, average award size, and the top NAICS markets represented in the FY2026 to date data.
